The '''Street Performers And Panhandlers' Guild''' was an organization on<ref name="TCG" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TCG" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/ccg/news20010810.html|text=Coruscant in Cards}} states that cards from the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game's]] ''[[Coruscant Limited]]'' expansion are drawn from {{Film|I}}, which takes place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Televan Koreyy]] served as leader of the guild and kept tight control over the other guild members.<ref name="TCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Street Performers And Panhandlers' Guild was mentioned in Televan Koreyy's card in [[2001]]'s ''[[Coruscant Limited]]'', an expansion of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] by [[Decipher]].<ref name="TCG" />
